name: SNT AUTOPART ENTERPRISE, LLC
old_description: Parts helping to keep your Car hard at work with long work days.
about:
SNT Autopart Enterprise, LLC is headquartered in New York, New York, operating from an office at 48 Wall Street, 11th Floor. The company, known as SNT Autopart Group, has accumulated over 30 years of experience in the design, research and development, and manufacturing of automotive spare parts. Its primary product line centers on oil seals.

The firm supplies parts for passenger cars, pickups, trucks, trailers, and heavy-duty equipment. Its catalogs cover Japanese, American, and European vehicle manufacturers, including brands such as Alfa Romeo, Audi, Mitsubishi Fuso, and Iveco, as well as aftermarket names like AC Delco, BPW, and Eaton/Spicer. Production follows ISO 9001:2015 quality management and ASTM standards.

Customers span the automotive aftermarket and commercial vehicle sectors, with the company positioning its components as direct replacements for original equipment. The product range is organized by vehicle make and by competitor brand, indicating a focus on distributors and repair networks seeking OEM-equivalent parts.

SNT highlights its competitive edge through a leadership team that includes an executive with more than seven years of R&D experience at one of the world’s top three automobile manufacturers. The company states that its parts match the characteristics of original spare parts while offering a competitive price point.
